reviews.title: AS3 foundation Batch 4: 3D geometry, AMF aliases, legacy XML, display/stage, graphics data and text
reviews.summary: Implements Matrix3D decompose/recompose/interpolate/pointAt, Orientation3D, Utils3D.pointTowards, flash.errors, AMF class aliases, flash.xml DOM, DisplayObject scale9Grid/lifecycle events, Stage/Sprite/Container methods, MouseCursorData, IGraphicsData/drawTriangles/lineBitmapStyle, BitmapData histogram/drawWithQuality, TextField htmlText/styleSheet and StaticText/TextSnapshot.

entries.note: All seven Flash Player flash.errors classes work; AIR-only SQLError, DRMManagerError and PermissionError extensions are outside the HTML5 target.
AMF class aliases, URL navigation/loading, SharedObject and NetConnection/NetStream file playback work; raw TCP/UDP sockets and P2P groups are outside the HTML5 profile.
ByteArray, Endian, Timer, Dictionary, intervals, getTimer and reflection helpers work; flash_proxy Proxy interception is outside the current AS3 profile.
Validates URLRequest and navigates through the browser window host; Flash cross-domain policy files do not apply in HTML5.
Validates URLRequest and dispatches an asynchronous browser fetch/beacon request subject to standard CORS rules.
Reads false and rejects programmatic pointer lock with IllegalOperationError outside active fullscreen user-gesture state.
Validates StageQuality and renders through BitmapData.draw; quality levels share standard HTML5 rasterization.
Parses HTML tags, links and CSS stylesheets into uniform TextField formatting; mixed multi-run formatting raises an explicit diagnostic.
Applies StyleSheet rules to uniform TextField HTML content; mixed multi-run formatting raises an explicit diagnostic.
